<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover" />
  <title>真心话大冒险 · 恋人牌局</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      /* ===== 日间模式（默认）===== */
      --bg-1: #fdf6f0;
      --bg-2: #faf0e6;
      --panel: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
      --panel-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      --glass-border: rgba(180, 140, 120, 0.18);
      --glass-shadow: rgba(180, 140, 100, 0.12);
      --text-1: #3d2c1e;
      --text-2: #8a7060;
      --text-3: #b8a090;
      --brand-1: #e8a4b8;
      --brand-2: #c88fa8;
      --accent: #d4849c;
      --ok: #7bc8a4;
      --warn: #e8b86d;
      --danger: #e07070;
      --zone-daily-1: #88c8d8;
      --zone-daily-2: #6bb8cc;
      --zone-love-1: #e8a0b4;
      --zone-love-2: #d88ca0;
      --zone-erotic-1: #b8a0d4;
      --zone-erotic-2: #a088c4;
      --card-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
      --card-face: #fff8f4;
      --card-back: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8a4b8 0%, #c0a0d0 50%, #88b8d0 100%);
      --card-back-pattern: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      --blob-1: #fce4ec;
      --blob-2: #f3e5f5;
      --blob-3: #e8eaf6;
      --body-bg: #fdf6f0;
      --dice-face-bg: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff8f4, #f0e8e0);
      --dice-pip: #5a3e30;
      --modal-bg: rgba(253, 246, 240, 0.95);
      --toast-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
      --theme-icon: '🌙';
      --float-heart-opacity: 0.08;
    }

    /* ===== 夜间模式 ===== */
    .dark {
      --bg-1: #1a1420;
      --bg-2: #201828;
      --panel: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      --panel-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
      --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
      --glass-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
      --text-1: #ece4e0;
      --text-2: #a898a0;
      --text-3: #786870;
      --brand-1: #d88ca8;
      --brand-2: #b878a0;
      --accent: #c47898;
      --ok: #5cb890;
      --warn: #d4a050;
      --danger: #d06060;
      --zone-daily-1: #60a8b8;
      --zone-daily-2: #5098ac;
      --zone-love-1: #c88098;
      --zone-love-2: #b87088;
      --zone-erotic-1: #9880b8;
      --zone-erotic-2: #8870a8;
      --card-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      --card-face: #2a2030;
      --card-back: linear-gradient(135deg, #c47898 0%, #9878b0 50%, #6898a8 100%);
      --card-back-pattern: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      --blob-1: rgba(200, 120, 160, 0.12);
      --blob-2: rgba(160, 120, 200, 0.10);
      --blob-3: rgba(120, 160, 200, 0.08);
      --body-bg: #1a1420;
      --dice-face-bg: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a2e40, #2a2030);
      --dice-pip: #e8d8d0;
      --modal-bg: rgba(26, 20, 32, 0.95);
      --toast-bg: rgba(40, 30, 48, 0.9);
      --theme-icon: '☀️';
      --float-heart-opacity: 0.04;
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
    html {
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: -webkit-fill-available;
      background: var(--body-bg);
      transition: background 0.5s ease;
    }
    html.dark {
      background: var(--body-bg);
    }
    body {
      width: 100vw; height: 100vh;
      height: -webkit-fill-available;
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: -webkit-fill-available;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      overflow-y: auto;
      margin: 0; padding: 0;
      font-family: ui-rounded, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
      color: var(--text-1);
      background: var(--body-bg);
      padding-top: max(44px, env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px));
      padding-bottom: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 16px));
      padding-left: env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px);
      padding-right: env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px);
      overscroll-behavior: none;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      transition: background 0.5s ease, color 0.3s ease;
    }

    /* 移动端适配 + iOS安全区 */
    @supports (padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top)) {
      body {
        padding-top: max(40px, env(safe-area-inset-top));
        padding-bottom: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
      }
    }

    /* ===== 实化背景装饰 ===== */
    .bg-pattern {
      position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 50% at 15% 10%, rgba(252,228,236,0.7) 0%, transparent 70%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 60% at 85% 80%, rgba(243,229,245,0.6) 0%, transparent 70%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 40% at 50% 50%, rgba(232,234,246,0.4) 0%, transparent 60%),
        repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent, transparent 60px, rgba(232,164,184,0.03) 60px, rgba(232,164,184,0.03) 61px),
        repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, transparent, transparent 60px, rgba(184,160,212,0.03) 60px, rgba(184,160,212,0.03) 61px);
    }
    .dark .bg-pattern {
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 50% at 15% 10%, rgba(36,24,40,0.8) 0%, transparent 70%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 60% at 85% 80%, rgba(32,24,48,0.7) 0%, transparent 70%),
        repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent, transparent 60px, rgba(200,120,160,0.02) 60px, rgba(200,120,160,0.02) 61px);
    }
    /* 顶部装饰条 */
    .bg-top-strip {
      position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 200px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(232,164,184,0.12) 0%, transparent 100%);
      pointer-events: none; z-index: 0;
    }
    .dark .bg-top-strip {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(200,120,152,0.08) 0%, transparent 100%);
    }
    /* 底部柔光 */
    .bg-bottom-glow {
      position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 180px;
      background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(184,160,212,0.08) 0%, transparent 100%);
      pointer-events: none; z-index: 0;
    }
    .dark .bg-bottom-glow {
      background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(100,80,140,0.06) 0%, transparent 100%);
    }
    /* 散点装饰 */
    .bg-dots {
      position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0;
      background-image: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(232,164,184,0.15) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 32px 32px;
    }
    .dark .bg-dots {
      background-image: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(200,120,160,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px);
    }

    /* 浮动爱心装饰 */
    .decor { position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; z-index: 1; }
    .float-heart {
      position: absolute; font-size: 20px; opacity: var(--float-heart-opacity);
      animation: floatHeart 18s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
    @keyframes floatHeart {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg) scale(1); }
      25% { transform: translateY(-30px) rotate(10deg) scale(1.1); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-15px) rotate(-5deg) scale(0.95); }
      75% { transform: translateY(-40px) rotate(8deg) scale(1.05); }
    }
    .blob { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(40px); }
    .b1 { width: 40vh; height: 40vh; left: -12vh; top: -8vh; background: var(--blob-1); opacity: 0.35; }
    .b2 { width: 34vh; height: 34vh; right: -10vh; top: 5vh; background: var(--blob-2); opacity: 0.3; }
    .b3 { width: 36vh; height: 36vh; left: 12vw; bottom: -14vh; background: var(--blob-3); opacity: 0.3; }

    /* 日夜切换按钮 */
    .theme-toggle {
      position: fixed; bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) + 20px); right: 16px;
      width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      background: var(--panel); backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 20px; z-index: 15;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px var(--glass-shadow);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, background 0.3s ease;
    }
    .theme-toggle:active { transform: scale(0.9); }

    /* 主容器 */
    #ui {
      position: relative; z-index: 2; width: 100%; min-height: 100%;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
      gap: 12px; padding: 18px 16px 80px;
      overflow-x: hidden; overflow-y: auto;
      overscroll-behavior-x: none;
      touch-action: pan-y;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      scrollbar-width: none; -ms-overflow-style: none;
    }
    #ui::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .header {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
      padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 999px;
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px); background: var(--panel-strong);
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 24px var(--glass-shadow), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    }
    .avatar {
      width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover;
      background: var(--panel); border: 2px solid var(--brand-1);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    }
    .name {
      font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-2);
      max-width: 80px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }
    .heart-dot {
      font-size: 14px; animation: heartbeat 1.5s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
    @keyframes heartbeat {
      0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
      50% { transform: scale(1.25); }
    }

    .title {
      margin-top: 2px; text-align: center;
      font-size: 22px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 3px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-1), var(--accent), var(--brand-2));
      -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }
    .subtitle { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-2); opacity: .85; letter-spacing: 1px; text-align: center; }

    /* 视图切换 */
    .view { display: none; width: min(92vw, 480px); }
    .view.active { display: block; animation: fadeSlideIn 0.4s ease; }
    @keyframes fadeSlideIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    /* 通用卡片 */
    .card {
      position: relative; width: 100%; min-height: 120px; margin-top: 6px;
      padding: 18px; border-radius: 20px;
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      background: var(--card-bg);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.1);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.1);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px var(--glass-shadow);
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: var(--text-1); margin-bottom: 10px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    }
    .hint { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-2); opacity: .85; line-height: 1.5; }

    /* 操作按钮 */
    .actions { margin-top: 14px; width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }
    .btn {
      padding: 12px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 14px;
      cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px;
      color: #fff;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-1), var(--brand-2));
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
      transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, filter 0.2s ease;
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .btn::after {
      content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 0%, transparent 60%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .btn:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.97); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }
    .btn.primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-1), var(--brand-2)); }
    .btn.secondary { color: var(--text-1); background: var(--panel-strong); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); }
    .btn.secondary::after { background: none; }
    .btn.ghost { color: var(--text-2); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); }
    .btn.ghost::after { background: none; }
    .btn.warn { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8b86d, #d4a050); }
    .btn.success { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ok), #5cb890); }
    .btn.danger { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--danger), #c05050); }
    .btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; filter: grayscale(0.3); }

    /* 角色选择 */
    .center { text-align: center; }
    .role-emoji { font-size: 40px; margin-bottom: 8px; }

    /* 题库选择 */
    .zone-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }
    .zone {
      position: relative; padding: 14px 10px; border-radius: 16px;
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      background: var(--panel); backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      cursor: pointer; text-align: center;
      transition: transform 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
    }
    .zone:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
    .zone.active { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px var(--glass-shadow); }
    .zone.active::after {
      content: '✓'; position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 8px;
      font-size: 11px; color: #fff; width: 18px; height: 18px;
      border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent);
      display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 900;
    }
    .zone[data-zone="日常区"].active { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(136,200,216,0.2), rgba(136,200,216,0.05)); }
    .zone[data-zone="情欲区"].active { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(232,160,180,0.2), rgba(232,160,180,0.05)); }
    .zone[data-zone="爱欲区"].active { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(184,160,212,0.2), rgba(184,160,212,0.05)); }
    .zone h4 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-1); }
    .zone .zone-emoji { font-size: 22px; display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .zone p { margin: 0; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-2); line-height: 1.4; }
    .badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; font-size: 10px; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--danger); color: #fff; }

    .switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px; }
    .toggle {
      width: 44px; height: 24px; border-radius: 999px; position: relative;
      background: var(--panel-strong); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); cursor: pointer;
    }
    .toggle::after {
      content: ''; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px;
      width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--text-2); transition: left 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }
    .toggle.on { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-1), var(--brand-2)); }
    .toggle.on::after { left: 23px; background: #fff; }

    .deck-list { margin-top: 10px; display: grid; gap: 6px; max-height: 140px; overflow-y: auto; }
    .deck-item {
      padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--panel);
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-2);
    }

    /* 提示词预览 */
    .prompt-preview {
      margin-top: 10px; padding: 10px; border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--panel); border: 1px dashed var(--glass-border);
      font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-3); line-height: 1.5;
      max-height: 80px; overflow-y: auto; display: none;
    }
    .prompt-preview.show { display: block; }

    /* 掷骰（3D） */
    .dice-wrap { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; align-items: center; justify-items: center; }
    .dice-player-label { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-2); font-weight: 600; margin-top: 6px; }
    .scene { width: 88px; height: 88px; perspective: 900px; }
    .dice3d { width: 88px; height: 88px; position: relative; }
    .cube { width: 100%; height: 100%; position: relative; transform-style: preserve-3d; transition: transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.26,1); }
    .face {
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: var(--dice-face-bg);
      border-radius: 14px;
      box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.3), 0 4px 16px var(--glass-shadow);
      display: grid; place-items: center;
    }
    .pip {
      width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--dice-pip);
      box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    }
    .face.one   { transform: rotateY(0deg) translateZ(44px); }
    .face.two   { transform: rotateX(-90deg) translateZ(44px); }
    .face.three { transform: rotateY(90deg) translateZ(44px); }
    .face.four  { transform: rotateY(-90deg) translateZ(44px); }
    .face.five  { transform: rotateX(90deg) translateZ(44px); }
    .face.six   { transform: rotateY(180deg) translateZ(44px); }
    .pips { position: relative; width: 68%; height: 68%; }
    .pips .p { position: absolute; }
    .p.c  { top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); }
    .p.tl { top: 8%;  left: 8%;  }
    .p.tr { top: 8%;  right: 8%; }
    .p.bl { bottom: 8%; left: 8%;  }
    .p.br { bottom: 8%; right: 8%; }
    .p.ml { top: 50%; left: 8%;  transform: translateY(-50%); }
    .p.mr { top: 50%; right: 8%; transform: translateY(-50%); }
    .vs-badge {
      font-weight: 900; font-size: 16px; text-align: center;
      color: var(--accent); letter-spacing: 2px; margin: 4px 0;
    }
    .result { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; color: var(--text-1); }

    /* ===== 抽卡：卡牌 UI ===== */
    .draw-stage { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }

    /* 卡牌容器 */
    .card-spread {
      display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 0;
      perspective: 1000px; padding: 16px 0;
      position: relative; min-height: 200px;
    }
    .game-card {
      width: 110px; height: 160px;
      position: relative;
      cursor: pointer;
      transform-style: preserve-3d;
      transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), margin 0.3s ease;
      border-radius: 14px;
    }
    @media (hover: hover) {
    .game-card:hover { transform: translateY(-12px) rotateY(0deg); z-index: 5; }
    }
    /* 扇形排列 */
    .game-card:nth-child(1) { transform: rotate(-12deg) translateY(8px); margin-right: -20px; }
    .game-card:nth-child(2) { transform: rotate(-6deg) translateY(2px); margin-right: -20px; }
    .game-card:nth-child(3) { transform: rotate(0deg); margin-right: -20px; }
    .game-card:nth-child(4) { transform: rotate(6deg) translateY(2px); margin-right: -20px; }
    .game-card:nth-child(5) { transform: rotate(12deg) translateY(8px); }

    @media (hover: hover) {
    .game-card:hover { z-index: 10; }
    .game-card:nth-child(1):hover { transform: rotate(-12deg) translateY(-12px) scale(1.05); }
    .game-card:nth-child(2):hover { transform: rotate(-6deg) translateY(-12px) scale(1.05); }
    .game-card:nth-child(3):hover { transform: translateY(-12px) scale(1.05); }
    .game-card:nth-child(4):hover { transform: rotate(6deg) translateY(-12px) scale(1.05); }
    .game-card:nth-child(5):hover { transform: rotate(12deg) translateY(-12px) scale(1.05); }
    }
    /* 移动端点击反馈 */
    @media (hover: none) {
    .game-card:active { transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.03); z-index: 10; transition: transform 0.15s ease; }
    }

    .card-inner {
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      position: relative;
      transform-style: preserve-3d;
      transition: transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
    }
    .game-card.flipped .card-inner { transform: rotateY(180deg); }

    .card-front, .card-back-face {
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      border-radius: 14px;
      backface-visibility: hidden;
      -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      padding: 10px;
    }
    .card-back-face {
      background: var(--card-back);
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 24px var(--glass-shadow), inset 0 0 30px var(--card-back-pattern), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .card-back-face::before {
      content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 7px;
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);

    .answer-skip-link {
      font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-3); cursor: pointer;
      text-decoration: underline; white-space: nowrap; margin-left: 8px;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .answer-skip-link:active { color: var(--accent); }

    /* ===== 聊天气泡通用 ===== */
    .chat-msg {
      display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 10px;

    .chat-msg.hidden { display: none; }
    @keyframes msgSlideIn {
      0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px) scale(0.95); }

    }
    @keyframes bubbleIn {
      0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px) scale(0.9); }
      100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }

    .chat-avatar {
      width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0;

      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
      border: 2px solid var(--glass-border);
    }
    .chat-msg.right .chat-avatar { border-color: var(--brand-1); }
    .chat-msg.left .chat-avatar { border-color: var(--accent); }

    .chat-bubble-wrap {
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-width: calc(100% - 56px);

    .chat-sender {
      font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 3px; padding: 0 6px;
      color: var(--text-3);

    .chat-bubble {
      position: relative;
      padding: 11px 16px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.65;
      white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word;

      transition: transform 0.2s ease;

      border-radius: 20px 20px 20px 20px;

      color: var(--text-2);
      font-size: 13px;

    /* "正在输入中..." 状态栏 */
    .typing-indicator {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;

    /* ===== 卡牌星尘粒子特效 ===== */
    .card-particles {
      position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden;

    function renderCardSpread() {
      const container = el('card-spread');
      const pool = decks.flatMap(d => d.cards.map(c => ({ ...c, _deck: d.name })));
      const sample = [...pool].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5).slice(0, 5);

      container.innerHTML = sample.map((c, i) => `
        <div class="game-card" data-idx="${i}">
          <div class="card-inner">
            <div class="card-back-face">
              <span class="back-icon">💌</span>
              <span class="back-text">翻开我</span>
            </div>
            <div class="card-front">
              <div class="card-type-badge ${c.type}">${c.type === 'truth' ? '💗 真心话' : '✨ 大冒险'}</div>
              <div class="card-text">${c.text}</div>
              <div class="card-deck-name">${c._deck}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');

      container.querySelectorAll('.game-card').forEach((node, i) => {
        node.addEventListener('click', () => {
          if (node.classList.contains('flipped')) return;
          node.classList.add('flipped');
          setTimeout(() => {
            runCard(sample[i]);
          }, 700);
        });
      });
    }

    // 角色随机抽卡
    async function charPickCard() {
      const c = pickRandomCard();
      if (!c) { toast('题库为空'); return; }
      await runCard(c);
    }

    // 展示卡牌内容（通用）
    function showChosenCard(card) {
      show(el('char-pick-area'), false);
      show(el('player-pick-area'), false);

      const display = el('chosen-display');
      display.classList.remove('show');
      el('chosen-type').className = `card-type-badge ${card.type}`;
      el('chosen-type').textContent = card.type === 'truth' ? '💗 真心话' : '✨ 大冒险';
      el('chosen-text').textContent = card.text;
      el('chosen-deck').textContent = `来自「${card._deck || '牌库'}」`;
      setTimeout(() => display.classList.add('show'), 50);
      show(display, true);
    }

    // 运行卡牌 —— 根据谁输了走不同流程
    async function runCard(card) {
      currentCard = card;
      showChosenCard(card);

      if (playerWin) {
        // 玩家赢了 → 角色(TA)接受挑战 → AI直接回答
        await charAnswerCard(card);
      } else {
        // 玩家输了 → 玩家需要回答 → 显示输入框
        showPlayerAnswerInput(card);
      }
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════
    // 流程A：角色输了，AI直接回答
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════
    async function charAnswerCard(card) {
      addChatTime();
      showTypingIndicator();

      if (!window.Nuojiji || typeof Nuojiji.ai !== 'function') {
        await delay(1200);
        removeTypingIndicator();
        await addAiBubblesSequentially(`（${charName} 在思考中...但智能助手未配置，你们可以面对面完成这个挑战哦～）`);
        show(el('post-actions'), true);
        return;
      }

      const charPersonality = charDesc
        ? `以下是你的角色设定，请严格按照此性格特征来说话和行动：\n${charDesc}`
        : '你是一个温柔体贴、善解人意的恋人。';

      const sysMsg = `你是「${charName}」。${charPersonality}
你正在和你的恋人「${userName}」玩真心话大冒险游戏。

角色扮演核心规则：
- 完全以「${charName}」的身份、口吻和个性特点来回答
- 说话方式、用词习惯、情感表达都要符合角色设定
- 如果角色设定中有特殊的语癖、口头禅、称呼方式，必须体现出来
- 如果是真心话：用第一人称真诚而有个性地回答（5~8 句话）
- 如果是大冒险：用文字生动描述你的行动和反应（3~5 句话）
- 融入角色该有的情感色彩（撒娇/傲娇/温柔/调皮/深情等）
- 不要跳出角色，不要说"作为AI"之类的话

**重要指令**：
- 绝对不要输出任何思考过程、分析、解释、推理或元评论。
- 不要使用“首先”，“然后”，“第一步”，“让我们分析一下”，“作为AI”等词语。
- 直接以角色的身份输出最终答案，不要有任何前缀或后缀。`;

      const userMsg = `当前区域：${zone}
卡牌类型：${card.type === 'truth' ? '真心话' : '大冒险'}
卡牌内容：${card.text}

请以${charName}的身份和独特说话风格直接回答，不要加任何前缀说明。`;

      let replyText;
      try {
        const resp = await Nuojiji.ai({
          messages: [{ role: 'system', content: sysMsg }, { role: 'user', content: userMsg }],
          maxTokens: 800
        });
        replyText = (resp?.success && resp.text)
          // ⬅️ 在这里插入正则 replace
          ? resp.text.replace(/<think>[\s\S]*?<\/think>|<thinking>[\s\S]*?<\/thinking>/gi, '').trim()
          : `（${charName} 想说些什么，但暂时没想好...你们可以面对面完成挑战哦～）`;
      } catch (e) {
        replyText = `（${charName} 暂时害羞了...你们可以面对面完成这个挑战！）`;
      }

      removeTypingIndicator();
      await addAiBubblesSequentially(replyText);
      show(el('post-actions'), true);
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════
    // 流程B：玩家输了，显示回答输入框
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════
    function showPlayerAnswerInput(card) {
      const answerArea = el('player-answer-area');
      const textarea = el('answer-textarea');
      textarea.value = '';

      // 根据卡牌类型设置提示
      if (card.type === 'truth') {
        el('answer-label-text').textContent = '轮到你回答真心话啦～';
        textarea.placeholder = '大胆说出你的真心话吧...';
        el('answer-hint').textContent = '💡 真心话就要真诚哦，说出你内心真实的想法～';
      } else {
        el('answer-label-text').textContent = '轮到你完成大冒险啦～';
        textarea.placeholder = '描述一下你做了什么 / 你的感受...';
        el('answer-hint').textContent = '💡 完成大冒险后，描述一下你做了什么或者此刻的感受吧～';
      }

      answerArea.classList.add('show');
      // 先滚动到输入框位置，确保可见
      setTimeout(() => {
        // 滚动到输入框底部，确保键盘弹出后不会被遮挡
        answerArea.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'end' });
        // 稍后聚焦，给滚动留出时间
        setTimeout(() => {
          textarea.focus();
          // 再次确保输入框可见（键盘弹出后）
          setTimeout(() => {
            answerArea.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'end' });
          }, 300);
        }, 200);
      }, 100);
    }

    // 提交用户回答
    async function submitPlayerAnswer(answerText) {
      // 隐藏输入框
      el('player-answer-area').classList.remove('show');

      // 用QQ气泡显示用户的回答
      addChatTime();
      addUserBubble(answerText);

      // 让角色对用户的回答做出回应
      await charReactToAnswer(answerText);
    }

    // 跳过回答
    async function skipPlayerAnswer() {
      el('player-answer-area').classList.remove('show');

      // 用QQ气泡显示跳过提示
      addChatTime();
      addUserBubble('（害羞地跳过了这个挑战 😜）');

      // 让角色对跳过做出回应
      await charReactToAnswer(null);
    }

    // 角色对用户回答的回应
    async function charReactToAnswer(playerAnswer) {
      // 显示"正在输入中..."
      showTypingIndicator();

      if (!window.Nuojiji || typeof Nuojiji.ai !== 'function') {
        await delay(1200);
        removeTypingIndicator();
        const fallbackText = playerAnswer
          ? `（${charName} 看到了你的回答，露出了甜甜的微笑～ 智能助手未配置，你们可以面对面聊聊感受哦）`
          : `（${charName} 笑了笑：没关系，下次再勇敢一点哦～）`;
        await addAiBubblesSequentially(fallbackText);
        show(el('post-actions'), true);
        return;
      }

      const card = currentCard;
      const reactPersonality = charDesc
        ? `以下是你的角色设定，请严格按照此性格特征来说话和行动：\n${charDesc}`
        : '你是一个温柔体贴、善解人意的恋人。';

      const sysMsg = `你是「${charName}」。${reactPersonality}
你正在和你的恋人「${userName}」玩真心话大冒险游戏。
这一轮「${userName}」输了，需要接受挑战。

角色扮演核心规则：
- 完全以「${charName}」的身份、口吻和个性特点来回应
- 说话方式、用词习惯、情感表达都要符合角色设定
- 如果角色设定中有特殊的语癖、口头禅、称呼方式，必须体现出来
- 对恋人的回答给出符合角色性格的回应（4~6 句话）
- 融入角色该有的情感色彩（撒娇/傲娇/温柔/调皮/深情等）
- 如果对方跳过了挑战，用符合角色性格的方式调侃或鼓励
- 不要跳出角色，不要说"作为AI"之类的话

**重要指令**：
- 绝对不要输出任何思考过程、分析、解释或推理
- 不要使用“首先”、“然后”、“让我们分析”等词语
- 直接输出角色的回应内容，不要有任何前缀或后缀 `;

      let userMsg;
      if (playerAnswer) {
        userMsg = `当前区域：${zone}
卡牌类型：${card?.type === 'truth' ? '真心话' : '大冒险'}
卡牌内容：${card?.text || ''}

「${userName}」的回答是：
${playerAnswer}

请以${charName}的身份对这个回答做出回应，表达你的感受和反应。不要加任何前缀说明。`;
      } else {
        userMsg = `当前区域：${zone}
卡牌类型：${card?.type === 'truth' ? '真心话' : '大冒险'}
卡牌内容：${card?.text || ''}

「${userName}」害羞地跳过了这个挑战。

请以${charName}的身份回应，可以调侃一下也可以鼓励TA。不要加任何前缀说明。`;
      }

      let replyText;
      try {
        const resp = await Nuojiji.ai({
          messages: [{ role: 'system', content: sysMsg }, { role: 'user', content: userMsg }],
          maxTokens: 1000
        });
        replyText = (resp?.success && resp.text)
          // ⬅️ 在这里插入正则 replace
          ? resp.text.replace(/<think>[\s\S]*?<\/think>|<thinking>[\s\S]*?<\/thinking>/gi, '').trim()
          : (playerAnswer
            ? `（${charName} 认真看完了你的回答，眼里满是温柔...）`
            : `（${charName} 轻轻戳了戳你：下次可不许跳过了哦～）`);
      } catch (e) {
        replyText = playerAnswer
          ? `（${charName} 被你的回答感动了，一时不知道说什么好...）`
          : `（${charName} 笑着摇了摇头：害羞鬼～）`;
      }

      removeTypingIndicator();
      await addAiBubblesSequentially(replyText);
      show(el('post-actions'), true);
    }

    // 分享结果
    async function shareGameResult() {
      // 保存当前状态以便恢复
      const savedView = currentView;

      if (!window.Nuojiji) {
        toast('请在 App 内使用分享功能');
        return;
      }

      const chosenText = el('chosen-text')?.textContent || '';
      const chatBubbles = el('chat-area')?.querySelectorAll('.chat-msg.left .chat-bubble') || [];
      const replyText = Array.from(chatBubbles).map(b => b.textContent).join(' ') || '';

      const shareData = {
        title: '真心话大冒险 💕',
        summary: `${userName} 和 ${charName} 的恋人牌局\n\n🃏 ${chosenText}\n\n💌 ${charName}：${replyText}`,
        accentColor: '#e8a4b8',
        badge: '💕 恋人挑战',
        footer: '真心话大冒险 · 恋人牌局'
      };

      try {
        if (typeof Nuojiji.shareResult === 'function') {
          await Nuojiji.shareResult(shareData);
          toast('分享成功 💕');
        } else if (typeof Nuojiji.share === 'function') {
          await Nuojiji.share(shareData);
          toast('分享成功 💕');
        } else {
          toast('分享功能不可用');
        }
      } catch (e) {
        toast('分享已取消');
      }

      // 分享完成后强制恢复页面渲染
      setTimeout(() => {
        currentView = savedView;
        forceRepaint();
      }, 300);
    }

    // 温和重绘页面（解决分享后白屏问题）
    function forceRepaint() {
      // 确保当前视图可见
      Object.values(views).forEach(id => el(id).classList.remove('active'));
      el(views[currentView]).classList.add('active');
      if (currentView === 'play') {
        show(el('post-actions'), true);
      }
      // 1) 临时移除 backdrop-filter 避免 WebView 合成层丢失
      const blurEls = document.querySelectorAll('.card, .header, .toast, .modal-card, .player-answer-area, .typing-status');
      blurEls.forEach(e => { e.style.backdropFilter = 'none'; e.style.webkitBackdropFilter = 'none'; });
      // 2) 轻量级重绘，避免display:none导致白屏
      document.body.style.opacity = '0.99';
      void document.body.offsetHeight;
      requestAnimationFrame(() => { document.body.style.opacity = ''; });
      // 3) 滚动归位
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
      el('ui').scrollTop = 0;
      // 4) 下一帧恢复 backdrop-filter
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          blurEls.forEach(e => { e.style.backdropFilter = ''; e.style.webkitBackdropFilter = ''; });
        });
      });
    }

    // 防抖：避免多个事件同时触发 forceRepaint
    let _repaintTimer = null;
    function debouncedRepaint() {
      if (_repaintTimer) clearTimeout(_repaintTimer);
      _repaintTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        _repaintTimer = null;
        forceRepaint();
      }, 150);
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════
    // 事件绑定
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════
    // 监听页面可见性变化和恢复事件（防止分享后白屏）
    let _wasHidden = false;
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
      if (document.hidden) {
        _wasHidden = true;
      } else if (_wasHidden) {
        _wasHidden = false;
        debouncedRepaint();
      }
    });
    window.addEventListener('pageshow', (e) => {
      if (e.persisted) debouncedRepaint();
    });
    // 移除 window focus 上的 debouncedRepaint，避免点击输入框时触发黑屏

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      loadProfile();

      // 日夜间切换
      el('theme-toggle').addEventListener('click', toggleTheme);

      // 角色选择
      el('pick-char').addEventListener('click', pickChar);
      el('skip-char').addEventListener('click', zoneEnter);

      // 区域选择
      document.querySelectorAll('.zone').forEach(z => z.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const target = z.getAttribute('data-zone');
        if (target === '爱欲区') {
          try {
            if (!localStorage.getItem('ageVerified18')) {
              el('age-modal').classList.add('on');
              return;
            }
          } catch (e) {
            // sandbox 下 localStorage 不可用
            el('age-modal').classList.add('on');
            return;
          }
        }
        zone = target;
        decks = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(BUILTIN[zone] || []));
        extraDecks = [];
        renderZone();
      }));

      const toggle = el('ai-toggle');
      toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const on = !toggle.classList.contains('on');
        toggle.classList.toggle('on', on);
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-checked', String(on));
        el('gen-ai-decks').disabled = !on;
        el('prompt-preview').classList.toggle('show', on);
        updatePromptPreview();
      });
      el('gen-ai-decks').addEventListener('click', genAiDecks);
      el('zone-next').addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (!(BUILTIN[zone] || []).length && !extraDecks.length) { toast('题库为空'); return; }
        cameFromPlay = false;
        goto('dice');
      });
      el('zone-back').addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (cameFromPlay) {
          cameFromPlay = false;
          goto('dice');
        } else {
          goto('role');
        }
      });

      // 掷骰
      el('roll').addEventListener('click', doRoll);
      el('dice-continue').addEventListener('click', enterPlay);
      el('dice-back').addEventListener('click', () => goto('zone'));

      // 抽卡与执行
      el('char-pick').addEventListener('click', charPickCard);
      el('play-restart').addEventListener('click', () => goto('dice'));
      el('play-restart2').addEventListener('click', () => goto('dice'));
      el('play-zone').addEventListener('click', () => {
        cameFromPlay = true;
        renderZone();
        goto('zone');
      });

      // 后续操作
      el('next-round').addEventListener('click', () => goto('dice'));
      el('share-result').addEventListener('click', shareGameResult);
      el('back-zone').addEventListener('click', () => {
        cameFromPlay = true;
        renderZone();
        goto('zone');
      });

      // 输入框获取焦点时滚动到可见区域（解决键盘遮挡）
      el('answer-textarea').addEventListener('focus', () => {
        setTimeout(() => {
          const area = el('player-answer-area');
          if (area && area.classList.contains('show')) {
            // 使用 block: 'end' 确保输入框底部可见，不被键盘遮挡
            area.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'end' });
          }
        }, 400);
      });

      // 监听 visualViewport 变化（iOS键盘弹出）
      if (window.visualViewport) {
        let _vpTimer = null;
        window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', () => {
          if (_vpTimer) clearTimeout(_vpTimer);
          _vpTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            _vpTimer = null;
            const area = el('player-answer-area');
            if (area && area.classList.contains('show')) {
              // 键盘弹出/收起时，确保输入框底部始终可见
              area.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'end' });
              // 额外的安全措施：如果还是看不到，强制滚动到底部
              setTimeout(() => {
                const uiEl = el('ui');
                if (uiEl && area.classList.contains('show')) {
                  const areaRect = area.getBoundingClientRect();
                  const vpHeight = window.visualViewport ? window.visualViewport.height : window.innerHeight;
                  // 如果输入框底部在视口外，强制滚动
                  if (areaRect.bottom > vpHeight || areaRect.top < 0) {
                    area.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'end' });
                  }
                }
              }, 150);
            }
          }, 250);
        });
      }

      // 用户回答：提交 & 跳过（添加防重复提交保护）
      el('submit-answer').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const btn = el('submit-answer');
        if (btn.disabled) return; // 防止重复提交
        
        const text = el('answer-textarea').value.trim();
        if (!text) { toast('写点什么再提交吧～'); return; }
        
        // 禁用按钮，防止重复点击
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = '提交中...';
        
        submitPlayerAnswer(text).finally(() => {
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.textContent = '提交回答 💕';
        });
      });
      
      el('skip-answer').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const btn = el('skip-answer');
        if (btn.disabled) return;
        
        btn.disabled = true;
        skipPlayerAnswer().finally(() => {
          btn.disabled = false;
        });
      });

      // 声明弹窗
      el('open-help').addEventListener('click', () => el('help-modal').classList.add('on'));
      el('help-close').addEventListener('click', () => el('help-modal').classList.remove('on'));

      // 年龄确认
      let ageVerified = false;
      el('age-ok')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
        ageVerified = true;
        try { localStorage.setItem('ageVerified18', '1'); } catch (e) { /* sandbox */ }
        el('age-modal')?.classList.remove('on');
        zone = '爱欲区';
        decks = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(BUILTIN[zone] || []));
        extraDecks = [];
        renderZone();
      });
      el('age-cancel')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
        el('age-modal')?.classList.remove('on');
        toast('已取消');
      });
    });
  </script>
</body>
